hypothesis.architecture: frozen BGE-M3 dense query embeddings; each typed catalogue operation is ranked by its maximum cosine against its query-disjoint positive R207 exemplars
hypothesis.difference_from_r255: measures raw operation retrieval only: no family centroids, domain boundary, OOS gate, classifier head, threshold, decision, veto or runtime integration

selection.source: R207 positive rows whose operation appears in typed catalogue R219
selection.inside: deduplicate by normalized query; reserve SHA-256 first one per represented operation, then SHA-256 remainder to exactly 256 evaluation queries
selection.overlap_rule: no normalized query may occur in both exemplar training and evaluation, even if source labels differ
selection.ranking: maximum cosine over all training queries of each operation; operations with no R207 positive exemplar are reported, never imputed

minimum_useful_comparison.top_8: A 28-to-8 shortlist needs 100% expected-operation recall in this query-disjoint population before it can justify any later full-path experiment.
minimum_useful_comparison.top_2: A 28-to-2 shortlist, the R134 latency lever, likewise needs 100% recall here before any later full-path experiment.
minimum_useful_comparison.limitation: R207 lacks exemplars for some catalogue operations; even a passing covered-population score cannot justify a production shortlist or claim full catalogue coverage.
